route.name: Notion Alternatives Without AI
route.description: Personal offline notes and locally available organized content in installed native apps, without activating optional AI tools. AFFiNE, AppFlowy and Anytype offer overlapping personal workflows; this is not full Notion parity, an AI-free interface promise, or a privacy/processing guarantee. Optional AI and agent integrations have separate setup and data-handling terms.

products.editorialNote: Native personal local documents and organization without invoking AI. AFFiNE AI is a separate Cloud/sign-in feature; optional AI UI and services remain available. No promise that all AI controls disappear.

Native personal notes and workspace organization using documented opt-in Smart Write/Edit. Opt-in AI does not establish an AI-free interface, no AI indexing in every mode, or no third-party processing when AI is enabled.

Native personal notes/object organization without installing or authorizing an AI agent. Official policy allows no AI; the agent toolkit requires separate setup and an API key. Experimental plans are not shipped feature guarantees; optional integrations can expose data to the chosen agent.
